review.imagery: Nine native brochure project renders were visually reviewed. The day exterior supplies the card and hero. Other views cover lobby, two evening exteriors, living room, bedroom, gym and two pool angles. Current website gallery scenes duplicate these brochure resources and are excluded from repeated gallery entries. Generic city/people photographs are excluded. Images depict proposed design. No dated construction photography or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Five home layouts and four floorplates retain their complete source pages. Numerical apartment areas are not printed. Private pools are drawn on the selected home sheets. Convertible labels require confirmation of the approved configuration and contractual area. All nine complete physical plan-pack pages 4–12 were individually reviewed. The five home sheets retain their pool and position keys, and the four floorplates distinguish ground, first, alternating even and alternating odd residential levels. Brochure pages 22–26 repeat the home layouts and add no unique sheet. The primary FAQ’s 623 sq ft minimum has no verified type or area basis and is not assigned to a drawing.
review.location: The complete original brochure page 10 was visually reviewed. All seven destinations share a within-20-minute upper limit, displayed with the explicit within qualifier. The current primary page agrees. Its embed q value is Portside By Samana Developers, without coordinates. The source-hashed receipt records the name-only reference, and project-name directions remain available. No map camera centre or neighbouring development coordinate is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML, original official brochure and microsite floor-plan/fact PDFs retain retrieval receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. Native image resources, complete drawing notices and individual physical-page links are preserved. Protected identity, text research, commercial terms and previous source qualifications are unchanged.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific apartment areas, approved convertible-layout configuration, a verified visitor entrance coordinate and dated construction photographs were not established. Journey figures remain developer estimates with unspecified mode and route.
